Bass one-shots for Columbia Street's bass channel.

Each .wav here becomes a WAVE choice on the BASS page after the four synth
voices (SUB, REESE, 808, GROWL). Its pitch is detected when it loads, and it
is played back pitched to the riff's notes. Up to 32 samples, up to 6 s each.

The curated set is TidalCycles' Dirt-Samples "jungbass" folder, fetched by
tools/fetch_samples.sh.
